About

A school the town trusts

Photo: school building or main gate

Samarth School started with one aim: good education for every child of Shahpura, taught in a safe and friendly environment.

We work closely with parents, keep classes small and track every child’s progress through the year.

  • Medium Hindi and English
  • Class size Up to 30 students
  • Safety CCTV and transport attendants
  • Parent contact Monthly meetings and updates

Classes and streams
